# Maintenance and languages

## Source files

- `data/accounts.json`: schema v3; shared profile IDs, handles, categories, original bios, follower counts, observation times, and profile URLs.
- `data/accounts.schema.json`: the data format.
- `locales/en.json`: default English interface and public-document templates.
- `locales/{zh-CN,ko,ja,ru,fr,es}.json`: six translated interfaces and document sets.
- `templates/README.md`: the common layout.
- `data/research-backlog.json`: pending additions, outside the published count.

Bios are original quotations and have no translated copies. JSON, CSV, and handle text are shared by all seven editions. README, public guides, forms, and statistics are localized. Code, tool adapters, names, and the unchanged MIT license remain shared.

## Refresh a profile

```sh
python scripts/fetch_profiles.py ACCOUNT_HANDLE --category research --output .tmp/account.json
```

The helper reads public fields through [FxEmbed](https://docs.fxembed.com/api/twitter/operations/2profilehandle/), checks the returned handle, ID, bio, and follower count, then writes a candidate record. Review it and update the matching canonical record; a failed request does not erase existing data. FxEmbed is a third-party relay and may cache upstream data. Observation time records when the response was read.

```sh
python scripts/catalog.py build
python scripts/catalog.py check
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
git diff --check
```

Generation and CI run offline. They validate data, duplicate IDs/handles, timestamps, seven-language coverage, local links, and output freshness. They do not fetch changing counts during PR checks. CSV uses UTF-8 BOM and prefixes formula-like cells for spreadsheet safety; JSON preserves the original bio text.

## Translate the interface

Edit English text, update the six translations, and review them. Run `python scripts/catalog.py digests` and copy the expected document digest only after checking the corresponding translations. Missing, extra, or stale interface/document translations fail CI. Profile changes do not invalidate interface translations.

Every public page links to its seven equivalents. English uses root/default paths; other community files use a locale suffix and guides use `docs/<locale>/`. Obsolete source-record pages and translated CSV copies were removed in v3.

## Protected main

Use a feature branch and PR. Main requires current `Catalog checks`, resolved conversations, and linear history. Force push and deletion are prohibited, including for administrators. The approval count is 0 with one maintainer. Merge with squash; never weaken protection temporarily. Actions use read-only permissions. No scheduled profile refresh is installed.
